grammar_title: 现在完成进行时(The Present Perfect Continuous Tense: have/has been doing)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 4 Discovering Useful Structures:现在完成进行时(have/has been doing),强调动作从过去持续/反复到现在,常与 for/since/all day/how long 连用。句子地道、逆境/探险主题、答案唯一。

points.point: 表从过去持续到现在的动作(for/since/all day/how long)
points.overview: 动作从过去某时一直延续到现在并可能继续,常与 for + 一段时间、since + 起点、all day、how long 连用 → 用 have/has been doing。

points.point: 强调动作的反复/持续,或刚结束留下明显结果
points.overview: 强调动作一直在反复进行,或动作刚停下但留下可见结果(累了/湿了/脏了)→ 用 have/has been doing 突出'一直在做'。

points.point: 与现在完成时(have done)、现在进行时(am doing)对照
points.overview: 强调'一直在做、还没必然完成'用 have/has been doing;强调'已完成/结果'用 have done;只说此刻在做用 am/is/are doing。看语境标志选择。

questions.stem: I ____ for this climb for months, and I finally feel ready.
questions.explanation: for months 表一段时间、动作持续到现在并可能继续 → have been training。

questions.stem: She ____ in her diary since the expedition first set off.
questions.explanation: since + 起点、动作从那时持续至今 → has been writing。

questions.stem: The crew ____ on rough seas for days before they reached the island.
questions.explanation: for days、动作持续到话语时间 → have been sailing。

questions.stem: How long ____ you ____ to join an Antarctic expedition?
questions.explanation: How long 问持续时间、强调愿望一直存在 → have been wanting。

questions.stem: We ____ against the cold all day, and it is still snowing hard.
questions.explanation: all day 表持续、动作仍在进行 → have been fighting。

questions.stem: My nephew ____ stories of brave explorers since he was five.
questions.explanation: since he was five、动作从过去持续至今 → has been collecting。

questions.stem: They ____ for a chance to be rescued ever since the ship sank.
questions.explanation: ever since + 过去事件、动作持续到现在 → have been waiting。

questions.stem: For the whole morning the leader ____ the resolution to push on.
questions.explanation: For the whole morning 表一段时间、动作持续 → has been discussing。

questions.stem: I ____ to phone the rescue base all afternoon, but no one answers.
questions.explanation: all afternoon、反复尝试持续至今 → have been trying。

questions.stem: He ____ how to be a navigator for over five years now.
questions.explanation: for over five years now、动作持续至今 → has been learning。

questions.stem: The dog ____ at the ice since dawn, as if it senses danger.
questions.explanation: since dawn、动作从过去延续到现在 → has been barking。

questions.stem: How long ____ the men ____ on Elephant Island so far?
questions.explanation: How long ... so far、问持续时间 → have been living。

questions.stem: We ____ this rocky shore for shelter for two hours without luck.
questions.explanation: for two hours、动作持续(且未达成结果)→ have been searching。

questions.stem: Frank ____ the others' meals ever since he was made the cook.
questions.explanation: ever since + 过去时间、动作持续至今 → has been cooking。

questions.stem: The storm ____ over the island for three days, with no sign of stopping.
questions.explanation: for three days、动作持续到现在并可能继续 → has been raging。

questions.stem: Since the ship was crushed, the crew ____ in tents on the ice.
questions.explanation: Since + 过去事件、动作持续至今 → have been sleeping。

questions.stem: I ____ my courage up since the moment we left the safe harbour.
questions.explanation: since the moment ...、动作从过去持续至今 → have been building。

questions.stem: Steve ____ rugby since the age of eight, and now he plays for the team.
questions.explanation: since the age of eight、动作持续至今 → has been playing。

questions.stem: The sailors ____ for South Georgia Island for many hours by now.
questions.explanation: for many hours by now、动作持续到现在 → have been rowing。

questions.stem: How long ____ your team ____ to overcome this difficulty?
questions.explanation: How long 问持续时间、强调持续努力 → have been trying。

questions.stem: You look exhausted—____ you ____ out in the cold again?
questions.explanation: 由'look exhausted'这一可见结果推断动作刚持续过 → have been working。

questions.stem: It ____ all morning, so the whole camp is wet through.
questions.explanation: all morning + 留下'camp is wet'的结果、强调持续 → has been raining。

questions.stem: His hands are sore because he ____ at the frozen rope for ages.
questions.explanation: 'hands are sore'是动作持续留下的结果、for ages → has been pulling。

questions.stem: Why are your boots so muddy? ____ you ____ across the marsh?
questions.explanation: 由'boots so muddy'这一可见结果推断刚持续过的动作 → have been walking。

questions.stem: Diane looks terrible today because she ____ much sleep all week.
questions.explanation: all week + 'looks terrible'的结果、强调持续 → hasn't been getting。

questions.stem: The men's eyes hurt; they ____ in the black smoke of the fire for hours.
questions.explanation: 'eyes hurt'是持续动作留下的结果、for hours → have been sitting。

questions.stem: Timmy looks tired and his hair is damp—he ____ rugby for two hours.
questions.explanation: 'tired… hair is damp'的可见结果 + for two hours → has been playing。

questions.stem: The kitchen smells of fat because the cook ____ seal meat all day.
questions.explanation: 'smells of fat'的结果 + all day、强调持续 → has been frying。

questions.stem: Your face is red and you're out of breath—____ you ____ up the hill?
questions.explanation: 'face is red… out of breath'的可见结果 → have you been running。

questions.stem: The deck is soaked; waves ____ over the side for the past hour.
questions.explanation: for the past hour + 'deck is soaked'的结果、强调反复持续 → have been washing。

questions.stem: He is covered in snow because he ____ the path clear all afternoon.
questions.explanation: 'covered in snow'的可见结果 + all afternoon → has been digging。

questions.stem: Why are your eyes so red? ____ you ____ over the bad news?
questions.explanation: 由'eyes so red'这一结果推断刚持续过的动作 → have you been crying。

questions.stem: The whole crew is shaking; they ____ in the freezing wind all night.
questions.explanation: all night + 'shaking'的可见结果、强调持续 → have been standing。

questions.stem: Her voice is hoarse because she ____ orders to the team for hours.
questions.explanation: 'voice is hoarse'的结果 + for hours → has been shouting。

questions.stem: The floor is full of ash; the fire ____ thick smoke all evening.
questions.explanation: 'full of ash'的结果 + all evening、强调持续 → has been giving。

questions.stem: You smell of smoke—____ you ____ the seal fat for the lamps again?
questions.explanation: 由'smell of smoke'推断刚持续过的动作 → have you been burning。

questions.stem: The ropes are worn through because the men ____ them all week.
questions.explanation: 'worn through'的结果 + all week、强调反复持续 → have been using。

questions.stem: He looks proud and dirty—he ____ the rescue boat ready since morning.
questions.explanation: 'proud and dirty'的可见结果 + since morning → has been getting。

questions.stem: The young sailor's hands are blistered; he ____ ice for water for hours.
questions.explanation: 'hands are blistered'的结果 + for hours → has been melting。

questions.stem: Why is the tent so untidy? ____ the men ____ through the supplies?
questions.explanation: 由'tent so untidy'这一结果推断刚持续过的动作 → have they been searching。

questions.stem: I ____ the research paper at last; you can read it now.
questions.explanation: 强调'已完成、有成果'→ have done(have finished),非进行体。

questions.stem: We ____ as a team for hours, and we are still not giving up.
questions.explanation: for hours + 'still not giving up'强调动作持续、未必完成 → have been working。

questions.stem: Look—Shackleton ____ away from the island in the small boat right now.
questions.explanation: right now、只描述此刻正在进行 → is sailing(现在进行时)。

questions.stem: The company ____ an advertising campaign, and it is now on every street.
questions.explanation: 强调'已发起、现已上街'的完成结果 → has launched(have done)。

questions.stem: He ____ the navy three times so far, but he has never been accepted.
questions.explanation: three times so far、强调'次数/已完成的尝试结果' → has tried(have done)。

questions.stem: They ____ for a way off the ice all day, but none has been found yet.
questions.explanation: all day + 'none found yet'强调持续未成 → have been looking。

questions.stem: Quiet, please—the navigator ____ the map at this very moment.
questions.explanation: at this very moment、只说此刻在做 → is reading(现在进行时)。

questions.stem: She ____ her diary, so the whole story of the voyage is now complete.
questions.explanation: 'story is now complete'强调完成结果 → has finished(have done)。

questions.stem: I ____ three penguins today, so we have enough food for the night.
questions.explanation: 'enough food now'强调已完成的数量结果 → have caught(have done)。

questions.stem: The men ____ the same songs since dusk to keep their spirits up.
questions.explanation: since dusk + 强调'一直在反复唱' → have been singing。

questions.stem: Don't disturb him—he ____ the broken motor in the corner now.
questions.explanation: now + 只描述此刻动作 → is fixing(现在进行时)。

questions.stem: We ____ the boat at last, and it is ready to set off.
questions.explanation: at last + 'ready now'强调完成结果 → have repaired(have done)。

questions.stem: He ____ his courage many times, and each test made him stronger.
questions.explanation: many times + 强调已完成的若干次结果 → has tested(have done)。

questions.stem: They ____ to reach the whaling station since early morning, exhausted but hopeful.
questions.explanation: since early morning + 'exhausted but hopeful'强调持续 → have been struggling。

questions.stem: Watch out—the ice ____ under our feet at this moment!
questions.explanation: at this moment、只说此刻正发生 → is cracking(现在进行时)。

questions.stem: The rescue ship ____, so everyone on the island is finally safe.
questions.explanation: 'finally safe'强调已到达的完成结果 → has arrived(have done)。

questions.stem: I ____ that book about Shackleton; here it is if you want it.
questions.explanation: 'here it is'强调读完、有结果 → have read(have done)。

questions.stem: The waves ____ against the rocks all night, and the noise never stops.
questions.explanation: all night + 'noise never stops'强调反复持续 → have been crashing。

questions.stem: Be careful—the captain ____ to the crew over there just now.
questions.explanation: over there just now、只描述此刻在做 → is speaking(现在进行时)。

questions.stem: We ____ our supplies carefully, so we know exactly what is left.
questions.explanation: 'know exactly what is left'强调完成的清点结果 → have counted(have done)。
